scope: Compare Native host opt-level 1 and 0 after the physical Core, LLM encoder, and compaction extractions. Core and other dependencies stay at opt-level 1. The subsequent lifecycle-contract move and private atomic-write visibility correction are outside this measured source.
method: Interleave baseline, candidate, baseline, candidate in one private sequential target. Clean only Native outputs before each build and retain dependencies. Build the canonical full+otel CLI, package without another compilation, restore with the canonical artifact verifier, and assert both CLI and Native source revisions. Run the actual sources, docs, and scripts audit groups, conformance slice 1/4, and its 64-case performance ratchet under the same four-core limit. Portable artifact receipt mode explicitly uses GITHUB_ACTIONS=true; this is a controlled emulation, not an observed GitHub-hosted CI run.
decision: Set only ci-cli's harn-vm package override to opt-level 0. Keep the root profile, extracted Core, assertions, overflow checks, and performance limits unchanged. Build plus packaging plus the longest consumer improves by 157.34 and 89.67 seconds in the two pairs, despite slower consumer execution. Actual CI on the final source still owns acceptance; no ten-minute p90 success is claimed.

evidence.checks: All four builds and packages exited zero. Every audit group and conformance slice emitted a success receipt with the exact source and clean tracked/index/untracked state before and after. Each conformance slice ran 569 cases with zero failures or skips; the 64-case performance ratchet passed with existing limits. Both restored identities match the source and full+otel feature contract.
evidence.recovery: The first baseline was retained after an absent tree-sitter CLI blocked preflight. Install declared Node dependencies, verify the generated parser, and resume its built archive. A missing portable CI freshness handoff then refused the audit before checks ran; restore again through the canonical verifier with its environment receipt and resume. Neither failure is counted as performance evidence.
evidence.caveats: The longest-consumer sum approximates the producer-to-proof path, excluding runner setup, scheduling, other Rust jobs, and publication checks. First-run dependency warmth and Harn check-cache warmth differ. The second pair is the warm comparison. Four pinned cores on an owned host do not reproduce hosted CPU speed or contention; other host work can affect times. Conformance uses slice 1/4, not the complete four-slice suite.
